name: Paris Grill, Paris Bar & Kadie’s Club
lede: A London restaurateur brought Bromic into all three of his venues, each with a different problem at the door. Through certified dealer Heatport, every site got its own answer: Eclipse, Tungsten and Platinum Electric.
data: A grill, a bar and a nightclub

beats: Paris Grill sits near Liverpool Street among the City’s towers, Paris Bar in an industrial-style brick building in Farringdon, and Kadie’s Club, a boutique nightclub, in Piccadilly.

Paris Grill’s entrance doubles as a smoking area that passers-by see. Paris Bar needed heat for outdoor dining and a quiet replacement for a loud HVAC heat curtain. At Kadie’s, a doorman works the entrance on chilly evenings.

Bromic’s heating experts visited each site. Two Eclipse Electric pendants on 24-inch straight poles warm the Paris Grill entrance; at Paris Bar a 6 kW Tungsten Electric covers the outdoor area and a Platinum Electric just inside replaces the heat curtain; a Tungsten Electric warms the door at Kadie’s.
